## Change

What changes for theme authors or users? Note any effect on saved settings, preset schema, renderer, or launchers.

## Verification

- [ ] Syntax and shared payload build checked.
- [ ] Relevant tests run; list commands, results, and platform gaps.
- [ ] For a renderer change, record the live Antigravity version or note that live verification was not run.
- [ ] Staged files exclude generated media, local settings and credentials; any new bundled asset has a source and redistribution terms.
